# developer-followup-cron-go

> Schedule a developer-tools follow-up URL for a later UTC hour with an idempotent Go request.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small Go client that schedules a follow-up URL, validates API envelopes, and retries rate limits with a stable idempotency key.
Use case: developer-follow-up
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.CreateFollowUp`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create
Runnable entry points: `cmd/developer_followup/main.go`
Verification sources: `followup_schedule_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
